instruction: The lamp room of a steampunk lighthouse: a giant faceted Fresnel lens assembly rotating on a geared brass turntable, the beam sweeping out over a stormy night sea, clockwork governors and winding drums, an oil reservoir with gauges, a workbench of lens tools, a spiral stair descending, rain streaking the windows, and waves crashing on rocks below.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Brass Lighthouse Lens Room. The lamp room of a steampunk lighthouse: a giant faceted Fresnel lens assembly rotating on a geared brass turntable, the beam sweeping out over a stormy night sea, clockwork governors and winding drums, an oil reservoir with gauges, a workbench of lens tools, a spiral stair descending, rain streaking the windows, and waves crashing on rocks below. Style: maritime steampunk. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
